title: acceptance suite
description: harness/suites/<class>.json: the acceptance suite of one residual class — sentences with the exact Japanese the transducer must produce. The suites action levels each case RIGHT / REFUSED / WRONG and the class is closed when all are RIGHT. A case that cites a corpus line ('dev 17' / 'test 160') must match that line's text (check_schemas), and its expectation then counts as a right verdict for the sentence item of the lattice.

sentence.description: lowercased corpus tokenization, single spaces, ending in . ? or !

citation.description: the corpus split and line this sentence is, when it is one
